scope: Separate Windows numerical validity and actual-core routing qualification; not MLX scalar equivalence or general acoustic calibration.

mac_runtime.capture: Actual native Mac Network::probe and frontend; actual loaded dylib and explicit Metal library identities.

legacy.existing_windows_result: whole passed; first_probe, partial_frame and silence failed. Retained unchanged; no waiver or replacement scalar threshold.

natural.selection: First two regular WAV members in each pinned data/{config}/audio/dev.tar.gz in archive order; match basenames to pinned data/{config}/dev.tsv for human transcript, ID and sample count. Never sort, choose or replace after inference.
natural.retained_source: Archive/TSV for all32 natural cases; prior quality-pilot bytes retained only for noisy stress and provenance comparison.
natural.source_common_confident_error: Measured acoustic failure; block activation recommendation pending owner decision, never mark correct.
natural.uncertain_errors: Retain and report label mistakes/uncertainty; do not call them correct or a calibration claim.

overlap.arithmetic: Compute each RMS in float64; attenuate each to min RMS; float32-rounded views, pad shorter to maximum length, average float32.

context.tail: Zero extend; at index480000 append finite1.0 if present. All equal base en_us-0 result bitexact per backend.

stress.ambiguity: Constructed stress, not natural code-switching or speech admission evidence; exact pinned source core outcome.

gates.scalar_drift_limit: No replacement scalar tolerance. Mandatory functional drift limit is zero changed actual-core categorical decisions.

freeze.before_mac: Contract, selectors, all raw float32 PCM hashes and derivation recipes.
freeze.before_windows: Pinned actual native Mac capture, actual core outcomes and capture SHA256.
freeze.failures: Fresh complete failure receipt and nonzero exit; preserve every selected case and all legacy failures; no retries for selection.

budget.spares: 16 only for A-B-A, fresh-session and cancellation isolation; never selection retries.

admission: Parent authorizes exact frozen graph inventory for qualification loading only after protocol review. Existing admit_model remains mandatory. Production dispatcher/setup activation requires passing actual adapter/behavior gate and owner quality decision.

amendment.timing: Before any model inference under either prospective contract. Old graph/reference evaluation failures remain unchanged.
amendment.reason: Viewer metadata endpoints exceed server Parquet scan limit. Use standard-library bounded archive streaming, with deterministic archive-order selection rather than Parquet-row selection.
amendment.acceptance: Numerical, routing, label, stress algorithms and112+1probe criteria unchanged. No inference-based selection or replacement.
amendment.stress_source_bytes: Quiet/clipped/mixed/short/context recipes now use v2 selected natural-en_us-0/fr_fr-1. Retained noise-fr-10db bytes unchanged.
amendment.metadata_budget: Complete pinned dev.tsv may use up to1MiB per config; aggregate60MiB corpus cap includes all prior failed transport attempts.
